mapper.select: select cast(event_time as date) as `day`,sum(received) received,sum(refunded) refunded,sum(placed) placed,sum(paid) paid,sum(completed) completed,sum(cancelled) cancelled from ( select o.order_time event_time,0 received,0 refunded,1 placed,0 paid,0 completed,0 cancelled from orders o where and o.order_time>=#{from} and o.order_time<#{until} union all select o.checkout_time event_time,o.amount received,0 refunded,0 placed,1 paid,0 completed,0 cancelled from orders o where and o.checkout_time>=#{from} and o.checkout_time<#{until} union all select o.delivery_time event_time,0 received,0 refunded,0 placed,0 paid,1 completed,0 cancelled from orders o where and o.delivery_time>=#{from} and o.delivery_time<#{until} and o.status=5 union all select o.cancel_time event_time,0 received,0 refunded,0 placed,0 paid,0 completed,1 cancelled from orders o where and o.cancel_time>=#{from} and o.cancel_time<#{until} and o.status=6 union all select r.updated_at event_time,0 received,r.amount_fen/100.0 refunded,0 placed,0 paid,0 completed,0 cancelled from orders o join refund_request r on r.order_id=o.id where and r.updated_at>=#{from} and r.updated_at<#{until} and r.status='SUCCESS' ) events group by 1

select d.dish_id dishId,d.setmeal_id setmealId,max(d.name) name,sum(d.number) quantity from orders o join order_detail d on d.order_id=o.id where and o.checkout_time>=#{from} and o.checkout_time<#{until} and not exists(select 1 from refund_request r where r.order_id=o.id and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.updated_at<#{until}) group by d.dish_id,d.setmeal_id order by quantity desc,d.dish_id,d.setmeal_id
select cast(o.status as char) name,count(*) quantity from orders o where and o.order_time>=#{from} and o.order_time<#{until} group by o.status

select cast(case when m.on_sale=1 and m.sold_out=0 and p.status=1 then 1 else 0 end as char) name,count(*) quantity from store_dish m join dish p on p.id=m.dish_idstore_setmeal m join setmeal p on p.id=m.setmeal_id where m.tenant_id=#{tenant} and p.tenant_id=m.tenant_id and m.store_id in #{s} group by 1

select o.id,o.number,o.store_id storeId,o.fulfillment_type fulfillmentType,d.dish_id dishId,d.setmeal_id setmealId, d.name,d.number quantity,d.amount,cast(o.checkout_time as char(19)) as `day`, case when exists(select 1 from refund_request r where r.order_id=o.id and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.updated_at<#{until}) then 'REFUNDED' else 'COUNTED' end event from orders o join order_detail d on d.order_id=o.id where and o.checkout_time>=#{from} and o.checkout_time<#{until} order by o.id,d.id limit 50001
